summary:
First the charge lasts an afternoon, then only until lunch. Then the trackpad starts lifting off the case. That's a swollen battery, and it's your cue to stop using the MacBook and get it seen to.

We replace MacBook Air batteries on every model, fitting OEM-grade cells and resealing properly. Common signs include fast drain, a "Service Battery" warning, shutting down at 20 to 40% charge, or a MacBook that only runs on the charger.

Prices depend on your model, from R2,000 on older Intel MacBook Airs up to about R3,100 on M-series models. Every job starts with a free diagnostic and carries a 6-month warranty.
